outputText: Subject: A large, tree-like creature with glowing yellow eyes and clawed hand, partially visible behind a mirrored partition, reaching out with one arm. Framing: Vertical medium shot capturing the creature’s upper body and arm, two lanterns on the floor (one upright emitting smoke, one toppled), and reflections in the mirrors. Lighting: Warm light from lanterns casting soft glows and shadows; ambient fluorescent ceiling lights providing cool, diffuse overhead illumination. Visible transformation: The creature’s arm extended forward, smoke rising from the upright lantern, broken orange shards and black debris scattered near the toppled lantern. Continuity: Maintain the creature’s reaching pose and smoky lantern as focal elements; preserve the mirrored reflections and office spatial layout with visible ceiling details and floor debris for seamless transition into the next scene.
